subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should maintainers sponsor a fresh or heavily rebased Control UI cron timeline from this branch, or leave the canonical feature issue open for a cleaner implementation?
rationale: The feature is plausible and screenshot-proven, but the branch is stale, dirty, and needs product ownership for the accepted timeline slice plus current-contract repair.

options.title: Request a fresh/rebased timeline PR
options.body: Keep the feature issue open and require a new or heavily rebased branch against the current cron page that fixes the status, scheduler, run-state, and i18n blockers.

options.title: Adopt and repair this branch
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly own the rebase and turn this branch into the landing vehicle despite its current stale shape.

options.title: Defer the cron calendar feature
options.body: Leave the canonical issue as backlog and stop treating this PR as the active implementation path.

recommendation.title: Request a fresh/rebased timeline PR
recommendation.body: Keep the feature issue open and require a new or heavily rebased branch against the current cron page that fixes the status, scheduler, run-state, and i18n blockers.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main blockers trace through cron status, scheduler, and Control UI paths recently touched in Peter Steinberger's current-main history.
